'''R3-A2'''<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> was an [[Color|orange]] and white [[R3-series astromech droid]]. It was seen in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Echo Base|base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Episode V" /> in [[3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]].</ref>
